remarks: This charming townhouse condo offers 2 spacious bedrooms and 1.5 bathrooms. Upon entering to the main level, you'll be greeted by a sun-filled, open-concept living and dining area, perfect for entertaining and everyday living. The living room features a cozy fireplace, creating a warm and inviting ambiance, and the wood flooring on the main level adds elegance. Upstairs, the primary bedroom is a true retreat with a large walk-in closet and direct access to the full bath. The second bedroom is generously sized with double closets. Downstairs, enjoy the convenience of garage access and a versatile room that can be used as a home office, gym, or additional storage. Located in a desirable area, this property provides easy access to local amenities, shopping, dining, and entertainment. Enjoy coastal living with proximity to the beach and parks. Don't miss the opportunity to own this delightful townhouse condo in Stamford!
